items.quote: Differential thermal analysis (DTA) was performed by using a Netzsch model 404S apparatus.

items.instrument: direct reaction drop calorimeter built in Genova and described elsewhere [19]
items.quote: Calorimetric measurement of the heat of formation of the intermediate compounds was performed using a direct reaction drop calorimeter built in Genova and described elsewhere [19].

items.calibration: intensities corrected for atomic number absorption and ̄uorescence were compared with those of standards (pure elements)
items.quote: Quantitative microanalysis of the phases was generally carried out by an energy-dispersive X-ray analyser; to this end the intensities corrected for atomic number absorption and ̄uorescence were compared with those of standards (pure elements).
The microstructure of the alloys was studied by standard optical and electronic micrographic methods.
A few samples were also prepared by arc-melting in order to avoid contact with the crucible at high temperature.

items.label: Samples for DTA and other measurements
items.quote: Samples for DTA and other measurements were also prepared in Ta crucibles from the pure elements.

items.label: Samples prepared in Genova for calorimetric measurements
items.quote: Samples prepared in Genova for calorimetric measurements were obtained by mixing powders of the pure elements Al (99.999 mass% purity, supplied by Koch Chemicals Ltd., Hertford, UK) and Sc (99.99 mass% purity, supplied by Inorganic Materials Ltd. Perm, Russia).
